issue.title: Mermaid diagram handoff from the research_swarm image agent to the linker
issue.description: A `#research_swarm` run with image or diagram work enabled gets zero to three validated Mermaid diagrams. The image agent proposes them in a companion manifest that binds each one to a passage of the lead's report, and the linker places them verbatim next to those passages in the published `<name>.md`. The lead's report is never edited, and no diagram failure ever blocks publication.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202610/research_swarm_mermaid_diagrams.md requests this work
